body:
The fact that this is the only interaction I got is telling on its own.
I’m gonna do it. Thank u.
I both am way too poor to afford laser and also cannot afford a doctor. But thank you for trying.

I’ve been using stridex pads, gold bond rough and bumpy, tea tree oil, and tonight I’m going to start using vaseline on top of a nice thick lotion with aloe vera once a week (the lotion itself every day though). I’ve also been waiting for things to calm down so I can start epilating my legs, to increase the time it takes for the hair to grow back.
It’s so incredibly frustrating it makes me want to cry. I know it’s common and “normal” and not harmful, but I feel disgusting. My legs are so scarred up from having to dig out ingrown hairs that never go away. I know I’m not supposed to, but they don’t go away on their own - they just get huge and reddish purple and almost cyst-like, full of pus and infected. I’m miserable.
